scripts.backend:dev: cd apps/backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd apps/frontend test:unit && cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/unit -v
scripts.test:integration: bun run --cwd apps/frontend test:integration && cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/integration -v
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
